cases.name: datetime-heavy
cases.datetime_policy: all four kinds; years 2024/2026; 0 or 6 fractional digits; exact minute offsets; no leap seconds

cases.name: finite-float-range
cases.float_policy: finite binary64 values, normal/subnormal, positive/negative, signed zero; exact bits checked outside timing; scaled sum disabled

limitations: Same final benchmark source and pinned compiler/GCC-O2 flags; baseline changes only writer.goose.
Different legal float spellings/output lengths; both semantic outputs independently checked.
Shared-host noise; descriptive medians, no significance or universal speed claim.
